name: Email (IMAP)
description: Watch IMAP mailboxes and start a configured routine when an allowed sender writes in.

accounts.label: Mailboxes
accounts.help: One entry per mailbox; the key is the account id used in state and logs.

accounts.*.host.label: IMAP host
accounts.*.host.help: Hostname of the mail server, e.g. imap.example.com.

accounts.*.secure.label: Implicit TLS
accounts.*.secure.help: On by default. Turning it off performs STARTTLS and is only allowed for a loopback host.

accounts.*.password.label: Password
accounts.*.password.help: Prefer env:GICLAW_IMAP_PASSWORD or an app password.

accounts.*.mailbox.label: Mailbox
accounts.*.mailbox.help: Default INBOX. Read-only: Giclaw never marks mail as seen.

accounts.*.watch.mode.label: Watch mode
accounts.*.watch.mode.help: auto uses IMAP IDLE when the server offers it, idle requires it, interval only polls.

accounts.*.watch.pollSeconds.label: Poll interval (seconds)
accounts.*.watch.pollSeconds.help: Also the reconciliation floor while IDLE is active.

accounts.*.allowedSenders.label: Allowed senders
accounts.*.allowedSenders.help: Required. A bare address (ops@example.com) or a whole domain (@example.com).

accounts.*.senderAuth.min.label: Minimum sender authentication
accounts.*.senderAuth.min.help: verified (default) needs a DMARC/DKIM pass Giclaw computed; asserted also trusts a listed delivery agent; unverified accepts DKIM/SPF evidence; mutable trusts the From header.

accounts.*.senderAuth.trustedAuthservIds.label: Trusted delivery agents
accounts.*.senderAuth.trustedAuthservIds.help: Authentication-Results authserv-ids whose dmarc=pass may be trusted.

accounts.*.senderAuth.acceptTrustedAuths.label: Accept listed delivery agents
accounts.*.senderAuth.acceptTrustedAuths.help: Only a listed authserv-id may confer trust, and only at the asserted level.

accounts.*.addressTokens.label: Address tokens
accounts.*.addressTokens.help: Plus-address suffixes (ops+TOKEN@example.com) that prove a sender knows a shared secret.

accounts.*.routine.label: Routine
accounts.*.routine.help: Routine started by an accepted message.

accounts.*.tasks.label: Tasks
accounts.*.tasks.help: Used when no routine is configured.

accounts.*.rateLimit.label: Rate limit
accounts.*.rateLimit.help: Accepted messages per sender within the window.

accounts.*.rejectUnauthorized.label: Verify TLS certificate
accounts.*.rejectUnauthorized.help: Set false only for a trusted internal server with a private certificate.

accounts.description: Mailbox accounts keyed by a simple account id.

secure.description: Implicit TLS on connect (default true); false performs STARTTLS.
